summary: Milestone 2026.10.706 completed 11 experiments (2 compute-bound, 9 synthesis-only) across 143.2 total wall-time minutes (averaging 13 minutes per experiment) reconstructed from disk-mtime fallback data. Execution wall time was concentrated in synthesis task 'Qualify service validation and replay preserved acquisition evidence' (39.41 minutes), followed by compute-bound task 'Measure independent Qwen requests through durable Python and Rust services' (35.63 minutes), synthesis task 'Bound complete-workload acceleration and retain all board obligations' (31.99 minutes), compute-bound task 'Capture bounded Qwen sentence evidence on fit and tune sources' (26.56 minutes), and synthesis task 'Inspect new live supervisor outcomes for transferable arm selection' (4.25 minutes). Point-in-time GPU monitor polling observed 0% utilization with 4MB allocated across both NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs outside active runs, and gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is recorded as false as neither compute-bound task exhibited idle anomalies or required multi-model parallel dispatch.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis tasks accounted for the largest individual execution latency, led by 'Qualify service validation and replay preserved acquisition evidence' (39.41 minutes) and 'Bound complete-workload acceleration and retain all board obligations' (31.99 minutes), which combined for 71.40 minutes (49.9% of milestone wall time).

Compute-bound execution consumed 62.19 minutes (43.4% of milestone wall time) across two single-model Qwen workloads without intra-task stage breakdown: 'Measure independent Qwen requests through durable Python and Rust services' (35.63 minutes) and 'Capture bounded Qwen sentence evidence on fit and tune sources' (26.56 minutes).
The top four slowest experiments combined for 133.59 minutes (93.3% of the 143.2 total milestone wall-time minutes), reflecting severe execution latency concentration.

Milestone timing relied on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction due to zero commits found on the live git-log path, leaving intra-task sub-phases (service validation, replay verification, Qwen request measurement, and sentence evidence capture) uninstrumented without granular telemetry.

Static GPU monitor polling provides only point-in-time snapshots (0% utilization, 4MB allocated across both RTX 3090 GPUs) rather than continuous execution-window telemetry during active compute-bound runs.
improvements_suggested: Profile and optimize the service validation and evidence replay pipeline in 'Qualify service validation and replay preserved acquisition evidence' (39.41 minutes) to reduce serialization and evaluation overhead.
Instrument experiment runners with granular intra-task sub-phase timers to isolate latency across model acquisition, request dispatch, inference passes, and receipt serialization.
Emit synchronous start and finish lifecycle timestamps directly into task result receipts during conductor execution to eliminate reliance on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
Deploy continuous in-flight accelerator telemetry sampling during compute-bound execution windows to dynamically measure GPU utilization and memory bandwidth.
Enforce DualGPURunner orchestration strictly for concurrent workloads executing two or more distinct models in parallel, avoiding misapplication to single-model Qwen tasks.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Profile and optimize the service validation and replay pipeline in 'Qualify service validation and replay preserved acquisition evidence' (which accounted for 39.41 minutes of milestone wall time).
Instrument experiment runners with granular intra-task sub-phase timers to isolate service validation, evidence replay, Qwen request processing, and artifact serialization latency.
Persist structured start and finish lifecycle timestamps directly into experiment receipt artifacts to replace disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
meta_reflection: Milestone 2026.10.706 completed 11 experiments (2 compute-bound, 9 synthesis-only) in 143.2 wall-time minutes, heavily concentrated in service validation replay (39.41 minutes) and independent Qwen service measurement (35.63 minutes). Point-in-time GPU monitor polling observed 0% utilization across both RTX 3090 GPUs with 4MB allocated outside active runs, and gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is false as the compute-bound tasks did not involve multi-model parallel execution. Highest-leverage operational gains lie in instrumenting granular intra-task phase timers and profiling validation replay latency, with estimated time savings set to 0% pending empirical phase telemetry.
